product.description: SR Studio™ by Monoprice™Over-Ear Closed-Back Pro Monitoring HeadphonesAccurate Playback for Home Setups and PodcastsDesigned to be your everyday studio reference for recording, mixing, mastering, and critical monitoring, these over-ear, closed-back pro monitoring headphones deliver a rich, natural, distortion-free sound that lets you hear your tracks accurately, ensuring the decisions you make in your DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) translate cleanly to speakers, live rigs, and streaming platforms.Large 50mm high-definition drivers and a wide, studio-grade frequency response provide detailed lows, clear mids, and smooth highs—without the exaggerated "smiley EQ" curve found on many consumer headphones. The closed-back, over-ear design offers strong passive isolation, helping reduce bleed into vocal mics and keeping you focused on the mix even in louder project studios or live sound environments.Built for long sessions, these pro audio studio headphones feature ultra-comfortable earpads and a lightweight fit that helps minimize fatigue during extended tracking, editing, or content creation. A detachable cable with a secure mini-XLR-style connector on the earcup and a 3.5mm plug on the opposite end makes the SR Studio™ by Monoprice™ Over-Ear Closed-Back Pro Monitoring Headphones a flexible choice for audio interfaces, mixers, laptops, and portable recorders—providing a dependable monitoring solution for home studios, project studios, podcast setups, and content creators.50mm high-definition drivers deliver accurate, studio-reference sound for recording, mixing, mastering, and critical monitoringClosed-back, over-ear studio design provides strong passive isolation, minimizing room noise and reducing headphone bleed into vocal and instrument micsUltra-comfortable earpads and a lightweight fit let you wear these studio monitoring headphones for long sessions with minimal listening fatigueTuned specifically for pro audio work, making these closed-back studio headphones ideal for music production, podcasting, streaming, and content creationWide 10Hz–36kHz frequency response offers full-range detail without hyped bass, so your headphone mixes translate more reliably to speakers and live systemsSingle-sided, detachable cable with a secure mini-XLR-style connector at the earcup and 3.5mm plug at the source integrates easily with audio interfaces, mixers, and laptopsDurable, studio-ready construction is built to handle everyday use in home studios, project studios, rehearsal spaces, and mobile recording rigsProfessional over-ear monitoring headphones that deliver pro-level results for creators at any level, from first-time producers to experienced engineers STUDIO-ACCURATE SOUND YOU CAN TRUST50mm high-definition drivers and a wide studio-grade frequency response deliver rich, natural, distortion-free sound. These over-ear studio headphones are tuned for accurate monitoring, so your recording, mixing, and mastering decisions translate reliably to speakers and live systems. CLOSED-BACK ISOLATION FOR TRACKING AND FOCUSThe over-ear closed-back design provides strong passive isolation that helps keep click tracks and cue mixes from bleeding into live mics. You get a cleaner recording and a more focused listening experience in home studios, project rooms, and live sound environments. ALL-DAY COMFORT FOR LONG SESSIONSSoft, cushioned earpads and a lightweight fit are built for long studio days.
